description: This file contains asynchronous test functions and helper methods that interact with a web API to test spend log retrieval, key and organization management, and report generation. It uses pytest and asyncio, with external dependencies on aiohttp for HTTP requests and pytest for testing structure.

methods.name: generate_key(session, models=[], team_id=None)
methods.description: Asynchronously generates an API key via a POST request to the /key/generate endpoint, optionally associating it with a team ID.

methods.name: chat_completion(session, key, model="gpt-3.5-turbo")
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous chat completion request to the /chat/completions endpoint using a provided API key.

methods.name: chat_completion_high_traffic(session, key, model="gpt-3.5-turbo")
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous high-traffic chat completion request with exception handling.

methods.name: get_spend_logs(session, request_id=None, api_key=None)
methods.description: Fetches spend logs via a GET request to /spend/logs, either by api_key or request_id.

methods.name: dict generate_org(session: aiohttp.ClientSession)
methods.description: Creates a new organization through the API with a unique alias.

methods.name: dict generate_team(session: aiohttp.ClientSession, org_id: str)
methods.description: Creates a new team within an organization via the API.

methods.name: test_spend_logs()
methods.description: Asynchronous test that creates a key, makes a chat completion request, and retrieves spend logs to verify they are recorded.

methods.name: test_spend_logs_with_org_id()
methods.description: Tests spend log retrieval with organization and team IDs, verifying metadata correctness.

methods.name: get_predict_spend_logs(session)
methods.description: Requests predicted spend logs for specific data via the API.

methods.name: get_spend_report(session, start_date, end_date)
methods.description: Fetches a spend report between specified start and end dates.

methods.name: test_get_predicted_spend_logs()
methods.description: Tests the predicted spend logs endpoint, verifying the response contains expected 'response' data.

methods.name: test_spend_logs_high_traffic()
methods.description: Performs load testing by issuing a large number of concurrent chat completion requests and verifying logs collection.

methods.name: test_spend_report_endpoint()
methods.description: Tests the spend report endpoint by requesting a report for the past 30 days and printing each record.

ctags.name: generate_team
ctags.pattern: /^async def generate_team(session: aiohttp.ClientSession, org_id: str) -> dict:$/
